verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.navan.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its content is written for agents: MCP setup, auth model, and guidance to keep payloads lean with date ranges, field filters and summary tools like `summarize_spend`. Agents can therefore be pointed directly at it. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs cover the REST API surface beyond MCP (e.g. an llms-full.txt or markdown API docs), and independent user corroboration.
